newsitem.title: USA: US Senate leader says "very close" on budget deal.
newsitem.headline: US Senate leader says "very close" on budget deal.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Wednesday he believed budget negotiators were "very close" on reaching an agreement with the White House.
Lott said he had spoken with President Clinton Tuesday.
"I still think we're very close, it won't be a perfect agreement from any viewpoint, but we are relatively close," Lott told reporters.
The Mississippi Republican said the "biggest sticking point" was that Clinton wanted more spending.

Lott said he was still "hopeful" an agreement could be reached Wednesday, saying the differences were in the range of $50 billion to $100 billion which "we ought to be able to find a way to work that out."
